text:
tess-ux: thinking aloud — lightweight "Quick save" for console analytics: capture current route + model + filter state as a sharable snapshot (no full dashboard) :sparkles:
anne-pm: sounds useful. is this different from saved queries? who owns it? :thinking_face:
tess-ux: yep different — saved queries are full persisted query objects in the library. quick save = ephemeral snapshot that users can pin/share; behind the scenes it can become a saved query if promoted. minimal friction flow. :zap:
mike-infra: backend concerns: ephemeral snapshots might explode storage if everyone pins lots. we need retention+quotas. what's expected ttl?
raj-telemetry: also want telemetry telemetry tags on a snapshot: route_id, model_variant, sample_rate, user_id (anonymized). we need to correlate later with cost/latency.
sam-backend: API sketch: POST /api/console/snapshots

```
{
  "scope": "route",        // route | route+model | global
  "route_id": "route_123",
  "model": "redwood-1.6b-quant",
  "filters": {"status":"error","latency_ms_gt":200},
  "note":"quick capture before rollout",
  "ttl_secs": 86400
}
```

sam-backend: response returns snapshot_id + share_url. minimal data store for indexes. no heavy materialized views.
tess-ux: UI idea: tiny toast "Saved snapshot — shareable link" with an action to promote to saved query (open modal). keep initial friction zero. :rocket:
anne-pm: rollout plan: soft launch to devs first, measure adoption. we should require opt-in telemetry flag before capturing user_id. privacy ok?
raj-telemetry: require opt-in. also add a derived telemetry field `snapshot_context` so paging/filters are searchable in analytics.
mike-infra: quota proposals: per-org snapshot quota + TTL default 7 days for quick saves, promotion to saved query consumes a slot from saved query quota. background GC job. also rate-limit POST to endpoint.
sam-backend: edge case: model variants — Should snapshot pin model version by default. otherwise a snapshot could show different performance later. pin_by_default = true?
tess-ux: UX says pin by default, but show small badge "pinned model v1.2" and allow toggle to follow latest. make copy clear.
anne-pm: ok. questions: sharing model pinned snapshots across orgs? permissions?
mike-infra: shareable URL should encode an access token with expiry. for org-internal sharing we map to authz check on view. public links disabled unless admin enables.
raj-telemetry: add an optional `eval_prompt_sets` field so snapshots used in regressions are linkable to evals.
sam-backend: implementation note: keep payload small; don't store full resultset. if user wants to export results, call export API that creates a job.
tess-ux: microcopy: primary CTA "Quick save snapshot"; secondary "Save & promote". keep iconography distinct from full saved query flow.
console-bot: deployed snapshot-service v0.1 to staging :partyparrot: — endpoint ready at /staging/api/console/snapshots
anne-pm: next steps: 1) agree TTL + quotas (mike) 2) API contract (sam) 3) telemetry fields (raj) 4) small UX mock (tess) 5) canary rollout to dev orgs (anne).
mike-infra: proposing defaults: ttl 7d, per-org quick-snapshots 250 active, promote->saved-query costs 1 saved query slot. feedback?
raj-telemetry: ok on defaults, pls add `snapshot_source` enum (ui|api|sdk) for attribution.
sam-backend: I'll draft OpenAPI spec and example responses, include error cases (quota_exceeded, auth). posting here later.
tess-ux: I'll drop a 2-slide mock in #design after lunch.
anne-pm: thanks all. can we do quick sync tomorrow 10am to lock API? :calendar: 
raj-telemetry: 10am works for me.
mike-infra: schedule added. :thumbsup:
